powers.name: Adaptation
powers.summary: Your body automatically adjusts to any environment, letting you breathe, move, perceive and survive in hostile or alien surroundings.

powers.name: Alternate Form
powers.summary: You can become a second form built as its own Hero at a power level up to yours (4 HP per level: Street 4 ... Iconic 24); every form pays the cost and they share the lowest Resolve.

mods.name: Independent Forms
mods.summary: Each form has its own identity, memories and personality.

powers.name: Animal Control
powers.summary: Roll against an animal's Willpower to make it obey you for the Power's duration.

mods.name: Calling
mods.summary: Reach animals out to Extreme Range; they come to you and the duration starts when they arrive.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: Limited to one category of animals; -4 if the group is very narrow or of little use.

powers.name: Animal Empathy
powers.summary: Animals sense your kinship and rarely attack you without strong reason, and may be talked down.

mods.name: Speech
mods.summary: You can actually converse with animals.

powers.name: Animal Mimicry
powers.summary: Gain a chosen animal's Powers and better physical Abilities, each capped at your Power rank; switching animals is a free action once per page.

mods.name: Enhanced
mods.summary: Replace the mimicked animal's single highest Trait with your Power rank.

mods.name: Selection
mods.summary: Mimic several animals at once using the best Traits of each, at -1d effective rank per extra animal.

powers.name: Animation
powers.summary: Bring images or objects to life for a scene; they get Agility, Might, Toughness and fitting Powers, one Trait at your rank and the rest at half. -1d per extra animated thing; Structure can't exceed your rank.

powers.name: Armor
powers.summary: Passive defense against physical and energy attacks; you are immune to attacks whose rank is at most half your Armor rank (unless Penetrating).

mods.name: Activated
mods.summary: Must be switched on (free action) and shuts off if you are knocked out.

mods.name: Reactive
mods.summary: Works as an active defense, like a shield or bracers you block with.

powers.name: Astral Projection
powers.summary: Leave your body as an astral form with Invisibility, Phasing (Intangible), Super Senses (Astral Sight) and Flight at your Willpower rank, while your body lies dormant.

powers.name: Attuned
powers.summary: You sense significant disturbances, events or powerful beings within a natural force, region or the cosmos you are attuned to; spend 1 Resolve for more detail.

powers.name: Aura
powers.summary: Your body deals one energy type to anyone touching or punching you (passive defenses only) and can be used for energy close attacks; mundane objects with lower Structure can't hurt you.

mods.name: Spines
mods.summary: Quills or spines deal physical damage instead, and give no protection against physical attacks.

powers.name: Banish
powers.summary: Roll against Willpower (or Toughness if chosen) or an active defense to send a target to another time, place or dimension until they are defeated.

powers.name: Blast
powers.summary: A damaging ranged attack of a damage type chosen at purchase.

mods.name: Block
mods.summary: Use Blast as an active defense against ranged attacks (not area attacks); forgoing your next action starts a 3-exchange blast duel.

mods.name: Melee
mods.summary: Use Blast as an active defense against close combat attacks.

mods.name: Subdual
mods.summary: Deals subdual damage.

mods.name: Weapons
mods.summary: Represents skill with a chosen weapon group; attack with your Blast rank only while armed, using the weapon's damage.

powers.name: Blending
powers.summary: +3d to Covert rolls to stay unseen; while motionless you can attempt to hide in plain sight at half that rank.

powers.name: Blind
powers.summary: Roll against Toughness or an active defense to blind a living target: -3d to its attacks and active defenses unless it can compensate.

powers.name: Blind Fighting
powers.summary: You suffer no penalties for darkness or unseen opponents in combat.

powers.name: Blink
powers.summary: Flicker in and out of reality in combat: use Blink in place of Might for close attacks and Agility for active defense and movement rolls (or a higher such Trait +1d).

powers.name: Boost

cost.note: costs the same Hero Points per rank as the Trait it boosts; that Trait is its baseline

powers.summary: Raises one chosen Ability, Talent or Power up to the Boost rank; must be given Cons describing when and how it works.

mods.name: Rage
mods.summary: Activates when you are furious; Intellect and all Talents drop to 1d while it lasts, ending by scene's end.

powers.name: Buff
powers.summary: Spend 1 Resolve and an action to give yourself and allies in the zone +1d on all challenge rolls for the scene; doesn't stack.

mods.name: Greater
mods.summary: Each extra Resolve spent adds +1d more, up to 3 Resolve for +3d. (Book prints the cost as '(6)' without a sign.)

powers.name: Clairvoyance
powers.summary: See distant places (or a familiar person/object) at any range; shielding requires a Willpower roll and other dimensions need a Superhuman (6) Willpower roll.

powers.name: Cloud Minds
powers.summary: Become undetectable to living minds within Distant Range unless they beat your rank with Willpower once you are close or noticeable; costs 1 action per page.

powers.name: Communications
powers.summary: Detect, receive, store and transmit communications over available networks worldwide without needing infrastructure.

powers.name: Constructs
powers.summary: Create solid force constructs with Structure and Might equal to your rank, usable to attack, grab or shield; -1d per extra construct.

mods.name: Devices
mods.summary: Build complex machines that mimic other Powers, like a broad Omni-Power.

powers.name: Danger Sense
powers.summary: Use this rank instead of Perception to sense danger and for Edge, and make active defenses even when surprised (at the lower rank).

powers.name: Darkness
powers.summary: Fill the zone with darkness, fog, smoke or similar; those who can't see through it take -3d to attacks and active defenses.

powers.name: Dazzle
powers.summary: Roll against Willpower or an active defense for everyone in the zone: stunned for one page, then blinded for the rest of the duration; can't be stacked.

mods.name: Deafen
mods.summary: After the stun, targets are deafened (-1d to all rolls) instead of blinded.

powers.name: Deflection
powers.summary: Active defense against one chosen type of ranged attack (not area); a failed attack can be redirected as a free action, -2d cumulative per extra redirect per page.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: Deflects just one specific object or energy type.

powers.name: Density
powers.summary: Grow denser: substitute Density for Might and Toughness and gain Armor at that rank (or existing Trait +1d); weight rank equals Density from 3d up.

powers.name: Detection
powers.summary: Sense and locate a chosen kind of thing out to Extreme Range, rolling only for faint or hidden traces.

mods.name: Long Range
mods.summary: Works at interplanetary distances, up to Plot Device Range.

powers.name: Determination
powers.summary: Start each issue with +1 Resolve per 5 Hero Points spent; has no rank, can't be affected by other Powers, Heroes only.

powers.name: Dimensional Travel
powers.summary: Spend an action to travel to other dimensions; free uses per issue equal Willpower, then 1 Resolve each.

mods.name: Portal
mods.summary: Open portals others can pass through.

powers.name: Dispel
powers.summary: Roll against an ongoing Power's rank to end its effect on a being or object; one Source only; also an active defense against special-effect Powers from that Source.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: Each additional Source adds +1 Hero Point per 2 ranks.

powers.name: Drain
powers.summary: Roll against the target's highest Trait of one Source; drained Abilities/Talents drop to 1d and Powers stop for the duration.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: Each additional Source adds +1 Hero Point per 2 ranks.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: -2 to affect only Abilities, Talents or Powers; -4 to affect only one specific Trait.

powers.name: Duplication
powers.summary: Spend an action to create a copy of yourself without this Power and without its own Resolve; can be bought again for more duplicates.

powers.name: Elemental Control
powers.summary: Create and control one element to mimic other Powers at this rank, like Constructs and/or a narrow Omni-Power.

mods.name: Matter Creation
mods.summary: Spend Resolve equal to the weight rank (min 1) to make created matter permanent.

mods.name: Only Control
mods.summary: Can only manipulate existing element within range, not create it.

powers.name: Emotion Control
powers.summary: Roll against Willpower to impose a strong emotion or mental state on a target.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: Only one specific emotion or state.

mods.name: Pheromones
mods.summary: Chemical: resisted by the better of Toughness or Willpower; non-breathers, life support and toxin immunity block it.

powers.name: Energy Absorption
powers.summary: Absorb one energy type: immune to it up to your rank, passive defense above that; spend absorbed ranks at once to boost an Ability, gain +1d, Blast, or heal.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: Absorb one more non-kinetic energy type per purchase.

powers.name: Ensnare
powers.summary: Roll against Might or an active defense to bind a target so it can't take physical actions; Aura counts as a passive defense.

mods.name: Line
mods.summary: A tether lets you reel in a snared target whose weight rank doesn't exceed your rank.

mods.name: Immobilize
mods.summary: Target is stuck in place but can still act physically.

powers.name: Evasion
powers.summary: Use Evasion instead of Agility for active defense, movement rolls and combat stunts (not a Travel Power).

powers.name: Expertise
powers.summary: A specialty under one Ability or Talent; use this rank instead of that Trait when it applies (baseline equals that Trait). Non-combat Expertise doesn't affect Resolve.

powers.name: Extra Limbs
powers.summary: Extra arms, tail, tentacles or similar give +2d when grappling and possibly other tasks.

powers.name: Flight
powers.summary: Travel Power for flying; effective rank is halved indoors unless the space is very large.

mods.name: Spaceflight
mods.summary: Faster-than-light travel in space.

mods.name: Gliding
mods.summary: Must descend at least a story per page unless riding an updraft.

mods.name: Levitation
mods.summary: Only straight up/down movement or hovering.

mods.name: Slides
mods.summary: Ride self-made slides; must stay within Distant Range of ground or large solid objects.

mods.name: Wings
mods.summary: Needs room and air; no flying in cramped spaces, thin atmosphere or vacuum.

powers.name: Force Field
powers.summary: Shaped field giving protected characters your rank as a passive defense vs physical and energy attacks, immune at half rank or less; not mental. Activate with an action, maintain free; -1d per extra field.

mods.name: Inviolate
mods.summary: Spend 1 Resolve when raising it to block all Power effects of equal or lower rank, including mental ones.

mods.name: Permeable
mods.summary: Attacks can pass out through the field in one direction.

mods.name: Collapsible
mods.summary: Collapses when hit by an attack above your rank and must be re-raised.

mods.name: Ward
mods.summary: Blocks mental attacks and effects instead of physical ones; can hold Intangible Phasers.

powers.name: Energy Form
powers.summary: Become one type of energy: gain Aura and Flight at this rank, weightless and immune to physical and energy attacks, but can't touch things and are vulnerable to effects on that energy.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: One more energy type per purchase.

powers.name: Gaseous Form
powers.summary: Become a gas with 1d Flight, immune to physical and energy attacks and able to pass through gaps, but unable to affect the physical world.

powers.name: Liquid Form
powers.summary: Become liquid or fine particles: immune to physical (not energy) attacks and able to flow through openings while still able to act physically.

powers.name: Solid Form
powers.summary: Become solid matter, substituting this rank for Might and Toughness and gaining Armor at it (or existing Trait +1d).

powers.name: Gestalt
powers.summary: Requires the Alter Ego Flaw; your powered form is the merger of two separate alter egos, with each additional alter ego costing 3 more.

powers.name: Growth
powers.summary: Grow larger: substitute Growth for Might and Toughness, gain Armor at it and Running at half (or Trait +1d); weight rank equals Growth from 4d up.

powers.name: Hard to Kill
powers.summary: Only extreme measures can kill you. In games where Heroes can die, the GM may charge 3 to 6 Hero Points instead.

powers.name: Healing
powers.summary: Heal touched characters, up to your rank in damage per day; may cure disease at GM discretion.

mods.name: Repair
mods.summary: Fixes machines, robots, vehicles and technology instead of living beings.

powers.name: Hibernation
powers.summary: Enter aware suspended animation indefinitely without needing air, food or water.

powers.name: Hyper Breath
powers.summary: Roll against Might or weight rank to push or pull targets (all in Close Range or one at Distant); 3+ net successes knock prone and cost a turn.

mods.name: Freezing
mods.summary: Freezing breath mimics Blast (cold) or Ensnare within Close Range.

powers.name: Illusions
powers.summary: Create real sights and sounds that fool people and devices; doubters roll Perception against your rank, and touching reveals them.

mods.name: Mental
mods.summary: Illusions exist only in minds (resisted by Willpower) and can impose Stun-like effects on single targets.

powers.name: Immortality
powers.summary: You don't stay dead and don't die of old age. In lethal games the GM may charge 6 to 12 Hero Points.

mods.name: Vulnerable
mods.summary: You can be permanently killed in some specific, difficult way.

powers.name: Immunity
powers.summary: Immune to chosen hazards, each bought separately: Attack X, Energy X, Environmental, Fatigue, Life Support, Mental States, Sensory, Toxins, or custom.

powers.name: Inanimate
powers.summary: Not truly alive: immune to physical attacks and Powers that only affect the living, with effective Immunity (Life Support, Toxins); still vulnerable to mental effects. Has a non-Trained Source and no rank.

mods.name: Mindless
mods.summary: Also immune to mental attacks and Powers.

powers.name: Invisibility
powers.summary: Become invisible; foes take -3d to attacks and active defenses against you, or -2d if they detect you by other means.

mods.name: Cloaking
mods.summary: Also hidden from Radar, visual Super Senses and equivalent sensors.

mods.name: Jamming
mods.summary: Not invisible, but undetectable to Radar, visual Super Senses and equivalent sensors.

powers.name: Irritant
powers.summary: Fill the zone with a hindering effect; others take -2d on non-passive-defense rolls unless Toughness (or Willpower, if chosen) exceeds your rank.

powers.name: Languages
powers.summary: Speak extra languages equal to your Intellect, chosen in advance or during play.

mods.name: Hyper Translation
mods.summary: Instantly fluent in any language you can perceive and pronounce.

mods.name: Polyglot
mods.summary: Learn new languages in about a week, basics in a day or two.

powers.name: Leadership
powers.summary: As a free action, let each ally you can see and talk to reroll one challenge roll per combat scene.

powers.name: Leaping
powers.summary: Travel Power for huge jumps (vertical reach is rank -1d); capped at Agility indoors; also an active defense against falls.

powers.name: Life Drain
powers.summary: Roll against Toughness (or Willpower) or an active defense: 1 damage per net success, healing yourself 1 per 2 damage dealt.

mods.name: Vampirism
mods.summary: Deals physical damage resisted normally and can hit inanimate targets, healing only from living ones.

powers.name: Light/Effect
powers.summary: Freely generate harmless light (filling the zone or a beam to Distant Range), or another innocuous environmental effect (called Effect).

powers.name: Lightning Reflexes
powers.summary: +6 Edge and instant weapon draws.

mods.name: Fighting/Marksmanship
mods.summary: Only applies to close combat or to ranged combat (pick one).

powers.name: Luck
powers.summary: Gain Luck dice equal to your rank each issue to add to your rolls or subtract successes from rolls against you.

mods.name: Control
mods.summary: Spend Luck on anyone within Distant Range at any time as a free action.

mods.name: Unbelievable
mods.summary: Spend Luck dice on lucky breaks, which can be more outlandish than Resolve-bought ones.

powers.name: Machine Control
powers.summary: Remotely control machines and electronics within Distant Range, using your rank to operate them; -1d per extra machine.

mods.name: Interface
mods.summary: Only computers, and anything they control.

powers.name: Martial Arts
powers.summary: Unarmed attack and defense with subdual damage; substitute for Might in grapples and stunts and for Abilities with mundane melee weapons.

mods.name: Deflect
mods.summary: Active defense against ranged physical and energy attacks (not area).

mods.name: Deflect Missiles
mods.summary: Active defense against ranged physical attacks (not area).

powers.name: Master of Disguise
powers.summary: Make convincing disguises quickly and mimic voices and mannerisms, rolling Charm vs Perception.

powers.name: Matter Chameleon
powers.summary: Take on a touched object's properties for the scene, like Solid Form capped by its Structure, plus Aura from its energy capped by that energy's rank.

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.summary: Psychic damage attack against Willpower; no effect on inanimate objects without a psychic presence.

powers.name: Mind Control
powers.summary: Roll against Willpower to command a living being within Distant Range, or spend 1 Resolve to plant a delayed suggestion; +2d to resist self-destructive orders.

mods.name: Hypnosis
mods.summary: Requires a calm face-to-face conversation; useless in combat.

mods.name: Pheromones
mods.summary: Chemical: resisted by the better of Toughness or Willpower; non-breathers, life support and toxin immunity block it.

powers.name: Nullify
powers.summary: Automatically suppress Traits of one Source at or below your rank for everyone in the zone; requires concentration (1 Resolve to act); targets can pay 1 Resolve per use to push through.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: Each additional Source adds +1 Hero Point per rank.

powers.name: Omni-Power
powers.summary: Mimic other Powers at this rank, -1d per additional use on the same page; default-rank Powers need rank at least their cost; certain Powers excluded. Pros cost Resolve per use unless bought on Omni-Power.

powers.name: Phasing
powers.summary: Go out of phase: immune to physical and energy attacks and able to pass through solids (not force fields) but can't affect anything physical; toggle once per turn.

mods.name: Intangible
mods.summary: Ordinary force fields can't hold you; Ward fields can unless your Willpower exceeds their rank.

powers.name: Plasticity
powers.summary: Stretchy body that can mimic effects by shaping itself, serves as passive defense vs physical attacks, and substitutes for Might in grapples and close combat.

powers.name: Polymorph
powers.summary: Roll against Toughness (or Willpower) or an active defense to turn a living being into a harmless form for the duration.

powers.name: Portable Storehouse
powers.summary: Call up mundane gear, weapons, armor or vehicles from a stash; they last for the scene unless backed by Resources or Wealth.

powers.name: Possession
powers.summary: Roll against Willpower to take over a living body within Distant Range, using its physical Traits and your mental ones; your body lies dormant.

mods.name: Meld
mods.summary: Your body merges into the host for the duration.

powers.name: Power Absorption
powers.summary: Touch and roll against the target's highest Trait of one Source to steal those Traits for the duration, knocking them out; -1d per extra victim.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: Each additional Source adds +1 Hero Point per rank.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: -2 to take only Abilities, Talents or Powers; -4 for one specific Trait.

powers.name: Power Mimicry
powers.summary: Touch and roll against the target's highest Trait of one Source to copy those Traits for the duration without harming them; -1d per extra source character.

mods.name: Also X
mods.summary: Each additional Source adds +1 Hero Point per rank.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: -2 to copy only Abilities, Talents or Powers; -4 for one specific Trait.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.summary: Spend escalating Resolve (1, 2, 3...) per scene to undo a character's just-finished turn and act immediately instead.

powers.name: Preparation
powers.summary: Makes Resolve-bought narrative details far more powerful when explained by prior planning (perfect item, prepared location, known info, contacts); no rank.

powers.name: Psi-Screen
powers.summary: Use instead of Willpower against mental attacks and effects, and to sense and resist mind reading and probes.

mods.name: Cloak Mind
mods.summary: Telepaths must beat your Psi-Screen rank to detect you.

powers.name: Psychometry
powers.summary: Learn the basic history of touched objects; spend 1 Resolve for details on a connected person or event.

powers.name: Quick Change
powers.summary: Change clothing and grooming instantly as an action.

mods.name: Costume
mods.summary: Only swaps between your costume and what you last wore.

powers.name: Radar
powers.summary: A radar sense gives a 3D picture of your surroundings, but not flat images.

mods.name: Sonar
mods.summary: Only works underwater.

mods.name: Tremor Sense
mods.summary: Senses ground vibrations instead, detecting only things touching or shaking the ground.

powers.name: Regeneration
powers.summary: Heal 1 damage per hour and wake up as soon as you heal a point.

mods.name: Fast
mods.summary: Heal 1 damage per minute.

mods.name: Instant
mods.summary: Heal 1 damage per page.

powers.name: Resistance
powers.summary: Use instead of Toughness to resist radiation, temperature extremes and toxins.

powers.name: Running
powers.summary: Travel Power for fast ground movement (also wheels, skating, bouncing); 3d baseline is normal human speed.

mods.name: Hover
mods.summary: Hover just above the ground, ignoring ground hazards and triggers.

powers.name: Separation
powers.summary: Detach body parts that act independently with whatever abilities make sense.

powers.name: Shockwave
powers.summary: Roll against Might or weight rank for everyone around you: push back with -1d until your next turn; 3+ net successes also knock prone and cost a turn.

powers.name: Shrinking
powers.summary: Shrink, lowering weight rank; substitute Shrinking for Agility and gain Leaping and Strike at half rank (or Trait +1d).

powers.name: Slay
powers.summary: Roll against Toughness (or Willpower) or an active defense to deal 2 damage per net success to a living target; ignores Armor.

powers.name: Slick
powers.summary: Make the ground slippery for the scene; crossers roll Agility vs your rank or fall prone, trapped with -2d until they stand; drivers roll Vehicles.

powers.name: Speak with Dead
powers.summary: Ask a corpse a number of truthful questions equal to your rank.

powers.name: Specialty
powers.summary: Street/Low Level only: each Hero takes one unique Specialty for +1d to certain rolls (can exceed Trait Cap) and 1 Resolve to make 6s explode on them; no rank.

powers.name: Spinning
powers.summary: Spin at super speed: use Spinning instead of Might for close combat, grapples and stunts, and instead of Agility to defend against physical attacks (or Ability +1d).

powers.name: Star Gate
powers.summary: Spend an action to travel to distant worlds; free uses per issue equal Willpower, then 1 Resolve each.

mods.name: Portal
mods.summary: Open portals others, including ships, can pass through.

powers.name: Stretching
powers.summary: Stretch your body to make close and grappling attacks at non-adjacent targets, out to Close, Distant or Extreme Range depending on version.

mods.name: Long Reach
mods.summary: Just long reach; you can't stretch your whole body.

powers.name: Strike
powers.summary: A damaging close combat attack and defense of a chosen damage type (claws, energized fists, etc.).

mods.name: Deflect
mods.summary: Active defense against ranged physical and energy attacks (not area).

mods.name: Deflect Missiles
mods.summary: Active defense against ranged physical attacks (not area).

mods.name: Reach/Throw
mods.summary: Hit opponents within Close Range via long reach or throwing.

mods.name: Sweep
mods.summary: Area attack in a 90-degree arc out to 5-25 feet (50 with Reach).

mods.name: Subdual
mods.summary: Deals subdual damage.

mods.name: Weapons
mods.summary: Represents skill with a chosen weapon group; attack and defend with Strike rank only while armed.

powers.name: Stun
powers.summary: Roll against Toughness (or Willpower) or an active defense to incapacitate a living target.

mods.name: EMP
mods.summary: Affects Tech-Source Inanimate characters and electronics instead of the living.

powers.name: Summoning

cost.note: 1 Hero Point per rank for every 2d of Minion Threat (round up), e.g. 5d-6d Threat = 3 HP per rank

powers.summary: Summon Minions per scene by rank (2 at 1d-2d up to 1,000 at 24d-26d) with a Threat chosen at purchase, capped at Trait Cap -6d (or -3d if 10 or fewer).

mods.name: Animals
mods.summary: Minions are animals with special traits: +1 per rank for a narrow selection, +2 per rank for a wide variety.

mods.name: Automatons
mods.summary: Minions have Inanimate (Mindless).

mods.name: Duplicates
mods.summary: Minions are copies of you sharing your unique abilities.

mods.name: Shooters
mods.summary: Minions can attack out to Distant Range.

mods.name: Unique
mods.summary: Minions get special abilities: +1 per rank minor, +2 moderate, +4 major; GM approval.

powers.name: Acute X
powers.summary: One chosen sense uses this rank instead of Perception for rolls involving it (not for Edge). Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Analytic X
powers.summary: Use one sense to learn a target's basic physical and chemical makeup. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Astral Sight
powers.summary: See the astral realm, letting you interact with spirits and astral projectors and spot Blending or Invisible living beings. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Circular Vision
powers.summary: Full 360-degree field of view. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Enhanced Hearing
powers.summary: Hear very faint or distant sounds with high-threshold Perception rolls, plus infrasound and ultrasound. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Hypersensitive Touch
powers.summary: Read print by touch and feel vibrations through walls. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Lie Detection
powers.summary: Automatically know when someone within Close Range is lying unless they are protected. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Microscopic Vision
powers.summary: Magnify vision as far as needed, down to tiny scales. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Night Vision
powers.summary: See in total darkness. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Radio Hearing
powers.summary: Hear and intercept radio transmissions. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Telescopic Vision
powers.summary: See fine detail at great distances. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Thermal Vision
powers.summary: See heat, including through thin objects and in the dark; foiled by matching temperatures. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Tracking Scent
powers.summary: Identify, track and read emotions by smell (threshold 4-6 rolls). Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: True Sight
powers.summary: See through disguises, illusions, transformations, Blending and Invisibility. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Ultra Vision
powers.summary: See ultraviolet and in very dim light, but not total darkness. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: X-Ray Vision
powers.summary: See through solid objects. Part of Super Senses, which counts as a single Power ranked at the higher of Perception or Acute X.

powers.name: Super Speed
powers.summary: Travel at this speed rank; Agility equals your rank, Edge is rank x3, usable for close attack and defense and grapple defense. At 9d+ gain extra benefits (2 range classes per page, run on water/walls, 2 Minions per net success, Quick Change and Vanish).

powers.name: Swimming
powers.summary: Travel Power through water; also breathe water, move and sense freely underwater, and ignore depth pressure and cold.

mods.name: Lungs
mods.summary: Can't breathe water but can hold your breath a long time.

powers.name: Swing Line
powers.summary: Travel Power for swinging between anchor points within Distant Range; lines have Structure equal to half your rank.

mods.name: Natural
mods.summary: Can't make lines; only works where vines or similar exist.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.summary: Move things at up to Distant Range with your rank as Might; attack, hold, throw, or actively defend against ranged attacks (energy needs a shielding object); -1d per extra object.

mods.name: Impel
mods.summary: Only straight-line pushes or holding in place, no fine control.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.summary: Sense minds, communicate mentally, read surface thoughts or probe memories within Distant Range, rolling against Willpower or Telepathy.

mods.name: Alter Memories
mods.summary: With 3+ net successes on a probe, rewrite memories for the scene, or permanently for 1 Resolve.

mods.name: Cloak Others
mods.summary: Hide the minds of everyone within Close Range from telepathy.

mods.name: Dream Travel
mods.summary: Enter others' dreams, where your physical Traits use Willpower or Telepathy.

mods.name: Mind Link
mods.summary: Link minds equal to your rank for shared communication within Extreme Range.

mods.name: Empathy
mods.summary: Limited to emotions and mental states, not words or images.

powers.name: Teleportation
powers.summary: Instantly travel distances set by rank as a move; unfamiliar destinations risk failure and a knockout; 1 Resolve for two jumps in a page.

mods.name: Portal
mods.summary: Open portals others can pass through.

mods.name: Medium
mods.summary: Only travel via a medium such as power lines, shadows or reflections.

powers.name: Time Stop
powers.summary: Freeze time in the zone for pages equal to your rank at escalating Resolve cost per scene; you can move things but not harm frozen targets.

powers.name: Time Travel
powers.summary: Spend an action to travel forward or back in time, under GM-defined rules.

mods.name: Portal
mods.summary: Open portals others can pass through.

powers.name: Total Recall
powers.summary: Perfectly remember what you attend to, with Intellect rolls to recall background details.

mods.name: Playback
mods.summary: Memories can be transferred, copied and displayed.

powers.name: Tracer
powers.summary: Tag touched objects to track them worldwide for the story; finding the tag needs a Daunting (3) Perception roll.

mods.name: Tracking
mods.summary: Track someone via a recently owned item or a place they visited in the last day.

powers.name: Animal Forms
powers.summary: Turn into familiar animals, taking their form and their physical Abilities and Powers capped at your rank. Changing is a free action on your turn.

mods.name: Enhanced
mods.summary: Replace the animal's single highest Trait with your Power rank.

mods.name: Only X
mods.summary: Limited to a category of animals; -4 for a single animal or very small group.

powers.name: Doppelganger
powers.summary: Become a perfect copy of any roughly humanoid person you've seen, fooling biometrics, without gaining their Traits.

powers.name: Object Forms
powers.summary: Turn into shapes, tools, weapons, machines or vehicles: exert rank force, add half rank to users' rolls, or gain machine traits up to your rank; resize as Growth/Shrinking at this rank.

powers.name: Shapeshifting
powers.summary: Reshape your body with Hero Points equal to your rank to temporarily raise Agility, Might, Toughness or buy body-based Powers; for Resolve, rank counts as Shapeshifting plus your best physical Ability.

powers.name: Transmutation
powers.summary: Alter touched matter's composition (gases in Close Range automatically; solids/liquids vs Structure or weight), changing Structure or state for the scene; 1 Resolve for permanence or unique substances.

powers.name: Tunneling
powers.summary: Travel Power for digging through the ground, leaving tunnels open or collapsed.

powers.name: Two-Dimensional
powers.summary: Become flat and shadow-like: weightless and silent, able to slide along any surface ignoring gravity and slip through cracks.

powers.name: Two-Fisted
powers.summary: Spend 1 Resolve to defeat 2 Minions per net success with a physical attack; +1d Weapon Bonus when dual-wielding mundane weapons.

mods.name: Fighting/Marksmanship
mods.summary: Only applies to close combat/melee weapons or to ranged combat/ranged weapons (pick one).

powers.name: Vanish
powers.summary: Using an action and movement, disappear and relocate up to a page's movement unseen.

powers.name: Variant
powers.summary: An alternate version of a Power you already have, worth the same Hero Points as the original after Pros/Cons; not allowed for Powers that affect other Traits.

powers.name: Ventriloquism
powers.summary: Mimic sounds and voices and throw your voice, rolling Charm vs Perception.

powers.name: Wall-Crawling
powers.summary: Cling to and move along walls and ceilings at normal speed; carrying capacity limited by rank if lower than Might.

powers.name: Weakness Detection
powers.summary: Spot weak points of what you observe; spend 1 Resolve to give your physical/energy attacks Penetrating against it for the scene.

generic_mods.name: Affect Inanimate
generic_mods.summary: A living-only Power can also affect Inanimate beings of one Source.

generic_mods.name: Area of Effect (Area)
generic_mods.summary: Ranged Power may target a 10-50 ft area or a single target, sized per use.

generic_mods.name: Area of Effect (Burst)
generic_mods.summary: Ranged Power always hits an area of fixed size (10-50 ft).

generic_mods.name: Area of Effect (Zone)
generic_mods.summary: May target the area 5-25 ft around you or a single target; +2 on Ranged Powers, +4 on Touch Powers.

generic_mods.name: Area of Effect (Nova)
generic_mods.summary: Always hits a fixed area 5-25 ft around you; +1 on Ranged Powers, +2 on Touch Powers.

generic_mods.name: Armor Piercing
generic_mods.summary: Halves passive defenses from mundane armor; incompatible with Weak.

generic_mods.name: Build-Up
generic_mods.summary: Usable only from the third page of action onward.

generic_mods.name: Burnout
generic_mods.summary: Roll 2 dice each use; 6 or less burns it out for the scene.

generic_mods.name: Carrier Attack
generic_mods.summary: On a hit, immediately make a follow-up attack with a separately bought carrier Power (passive defenses only).

generic_mods.name: Charges
generic_mods.summary: Limited uses per scene: -1 for 6, -2 for 3, -4 for 1.

generic_mods.name: Close
generic_mods.summary: Touch Power can reach targets within Close Range.

generic_mods.name: Close
generic_mods.summary: Ranged Power is limited to Close Range.

generic_mods.name: Concentration
generic_mods.summary: Using it prevents other actions, movement and defense until your next turn; ongoing effects need continued focus.

generic_mods.name: Conditional
generic_mods.summary: Only works under certain conditions: -1 often, -2 occasionally, -4 rarely.

generic_mods.name: Constant
generic_mods.summary: Always on and can't be turned off.

generic_mods.name: Contagious
generic_mods.summary: Anyone touching an affected target can be attacked too and becomes contagious.

generic_mods.name: Costly
generic_mods.summary: Each use costs 1 Resolve.

generic_mods.name: Degrades
generic_mods.summary: Loses 1d per use for the scene.

generic_mods.name: Delay
generic_mods.summary: Takes effect after a fixed delay too long to matter in combat.

generic_mods.name: Exclusive
generic_mods.summary: Can't be used alongside other Exclusive Powers; must be on at least 2 Powers.

generic_mods.name: Expansive
generic_mods.summary: Zone Power: spend 1 Resolve to enlarge the area for the scene: +6 Close, +12 Distant, +18 Extreme Range.

generic_mods.name: Fuse
generic_mods.summary: Set the Power to trigger after a chosen delay up to Willpower hours; can cancel within Extreme Range.

generic_mods.name: Harmful
generic_mods.summary: Hurts you each use: -1 for 1 damage, -2 for 1-3, -4 for 1-6; 1 Resolve avoids it.

generic_mods.name: Imbue
generic_mods.summary: A self-only Power can be granted by touch to up to Willpower subjects.

generic_mods.name: Independent
generic_mods.summary: The Power acts as a separate character on pages you let it.

generic_mods.name: Item
generic_mods.summary: Comes from a carried or worn item, mundane or unbreakable; on Abilities/Talents the rank drops to 2d without it.

generic_mods.name: Limited
generic_mods.summary: Catch-all reduction in usefulness: -1 somewhat, -2 significantly, -4 severely.

generic_mods.name: Line of Sight
generic_mods.summary: Reach Extreme Range: +2 from Distant, +4 from Close, +6 from Touch (+4 for Strike (Throw)).

generic_mods.name: Ongoing
generic_mods.summary: Damage continues at 1 per page for pages equal to the initial damage.

generic_mods.name: Only Inanimate
generic_mods.summary: Living-only Power affects Inanimate beings instead: -1 any Source, -2 two Sources, -4 one Source.

generic_mods.name: Overkill

cost.note: reduces base cost by 1 Hero Point per rank (1/rank becomes 1 per 2 ranks)

generic_mods.summary: Targets double successes on active defenses against it.

generic_mods.name: Overload
generic_mods.summary: Boost +3d for one page (lose it for the scene) or +6d (lose it for the issue).

generic_mods.name: Penetrating
generic_mods.summary: Halves passive defenses except Force Field; incompatible with Weak.

generic_mods.name: Phase Shift
generic_mods.summary: Affects incorporeal targets as if solid, and lets phased users affect solid ones.

generic_mods.name: Ranged
generic_mods.summary: Reach Distant Range: +2 from Close, +4 from Touch (+2 for Strike (Throw)).

generic_mods.name: Readied
generic_mods.summary: Must spend a page (or an action and 1 Resolve) readying between uses.

generic_mods.name: Recharge
generic_mods.summary: Usable only once every 3 pages.

generic_mods.name: Resisted
generic_mods.summary: Special-effect Power can't be resisted with active defenses; GM approval.

generic_mods.name: Ricochet
generic_mods.summary: Bank shots around cover without penalty; 1 Resolve to defeat 2 Minions per net success.

generic_mods.name: Selective
generic_mods.summary: Doesn't affect anyone you don't want; 1 Resolve to pick targets within an area attack.

generic_mods.name: Shutdown
generic_mods.summary: Something blocks or switches it off: -1 often works, -2 occasionally, -4 rarely.

generic_mods.name: Side Effect
generic_mods.summary: Detrimental side effect: -1 annoying, -2 harmful, -4 catastrophic.

generic_mods.name: Signature
generic_mods.summary: Leaves a traceable signature.

generic_mods.name: Subtle
generic_mods.summary: No noise, light or other easily noticed signs at a distance.

generic_mods.name: Undetectable
generic_mods.summary: Can't be detected or traced by ordinary senses; -3d to active defenses against such attacks.

generic_mods.name: Sustained
generic_mods.summary: Costs 1 action per page to maintain.

generic_mods.name: Touch
generic_mods.summary: Requires contact: -2 from Close Range, -4 from Distant Range.

generic_mods.name: Toxin
generic_mods.summary: A disease, drug or poison; toxin immunity blocks it and Resistance defends.

generic_mods.name: Trap
generic_mods.summary: Set the Power as a trap on a small area or object; up to Willpower traps at once.

generic_mods.name: Two-Handed
generic_mods.summary: Needs both hands free.

generic_mods.name: Uncontrolled
generic_mods.summary: Activates on its own in certain situations.

generic_mods.name: Unreliable
generic_mods.summary: Roll 2 dice each use; 6 or less fails and wastes the action.

generic_mods.name: Weak

cost.note: reduces base cost by 1 Hero Point per rank (1/rank becomes 1 per 2 ranks)

generic_mods.summary: Targets double successes on passive defenses; incompatible with Armor Piercing and Penetrating.

perks.name: Authority
perks.summary: Special legal or social powers such as clearances, immunity or arrest authority.

perks.name: Contacts
perks.summary: People in a chosen field who provide information and favors.

perks.name: Fame
perks.summary: You are famous and recognized favorably (civilian or heroic identity).

perks.name: Fourth Wall
perks.summary: Earn 1 Resolve once per scene when a fourth-wall joke gets the table laughing.

perks.name: Headquarters
perks.summary: A base of operations; each Hero Point buys 3 Base Points.

perks.name: Patron
perks.summary: A backer supplies information, gear, funding and support.

perks.name: Pet/Sidekick
perks.summary: A companion built with 10 Hero Points per Hero Point spent, up to half yours.

perks.name: Reputation
perks.summary: Credibility and respect in a particular field.

perks.name: Resources
perks.summary: Access to a supply of specialized equipment, without being rich.

perks.name: Unique Vehicle
perks.summary: Custom vehicles; each Hero Point buys 25 Vehicle Points.

perks.name: Wealth/Great Wealth
perks.summary: Truly rich (3) or among the world's richest, with a once-per-issue absurd purchase for 1 Resolve (6).

flaws.name: Absentminded
flaws.summary: You forget things, sometimes important ones.

flaws.name: Alter Ego
flaws.summary: A mundane alter ego built on 50 Hero Points that earns 1 per 5 you earn.

flaws.name: Amnesia
flaws.summary: No memory of your past; counts as both Plot Hook and Condition (+1 Resolve per issue).

flaws.name: Aversion/Fear
flaws.summary: You avoid something and react badly when you can't.

flaws.name: Beast
flaws.summary: Animal-level intellect that struggles with complex reasoning.

flaws.name: Blind/Deaf
flaws.summary: Fully blind or deaf; may need a compensating Power.

flaws.name: Broke
flaws.summary: No money, job or possibly home.

flaws.name: Clumsy
flaws.summary: You tend to break things.

flaws.name: Code
flaws.summary: A strict code of conduct beyond ordinary heroism.

flaws.name: Color Blind
flaws.summary: You can't see or distinguish certain colors.

flaws.name: Compulsion/Severe Compulsion
flaws.summary: An urge you struggle to resist; a truly irresistible one is a Severe Compulsion (Condition).

flaws.name: Creepy
flaws.summary: You unsettle children, psychics and animals.

flaws.name: Curse
flaws.summary: A supernatural burden of your design, with GM approval.

flaws.name: Decorum
flaws.summary: You insist on proper manners and social rules.

flaws.name: Disabled
flaws.summary: A physical disability; may need a compensating Power.

flaws.name: Emotionless
flaws.summary: You lack empathy and come across coldly.

flaws.name: Enemy
flaws.summary: Someone or some group wants you ruined.

flaws.name: Finite Power
flaws.summary: A Power relies on a resource that can run out.

flaws.name: Flashbacks/Guilt
flaws.summary: Triggers leave you helpless for a page or at -2d for 3 pages.

flaws.name: Frenzy
flaws.summary: You rush in recklessly and may go berserk.

flaws.name: Frightening
flaws.summary: Your appearance terrifies most people.

flaws.name: Heavy/Very Heavy
flaws.summary: Weight 5d-6d (Heavy, ordinary) or 7d+ (Very Heavy, Condition).

flaws.name: Hidden Agenda
flaws.summary: Secret goals you won't share with allies.

flaws.name: Illiterate
flaws.summary: You can't read or write a known Earth language.

flaws.name: Impaired Sense
flaws.summary: Poor hearing, smell or vision; you may choose to fail Perception rolls.

flaws.name: Insane
flaws.summary: Persistent delusions, breaks with reality or psychotic episodes.

flaws.name: Light Sensitive
flaws.summary: Bright light disorients or incapacitates you.

flaws.name: Mute
flaws.summary: Your Hero can't, won't or can't be understood when speaking.

flaws.name: Night Blind
flaws.summary: Dim light is nearly darkness to you.

flaws.name: Nocturnal
flaws.summary: Sluggish by day or prone to dozing off.

flaws.name: Notoriety
flaws.summary: A bad reputation makes people react poorly.

flaws.name: Obligation
flaws.summary: A duty such as school or a job constrains you.

flaws.name: Outsider
flaws.summary: From another time, world or dimension and unfamiliar with local norms.

flaws.name: Power Limits
flaws.summary: A self-controlled Power limitation that earns Resolve instead of reducing cost.

flaws.name: Quirk
flaws.summary: An unfortunate personality trait that flares at bad times.

flaws.name: Reaction/Severe Reaction
flaws.summary: Adverse reactions to a trigger; an irresistible one is a Severe Reaction (Condition).

flaws.name: Relationship
flaws.summary: Friends, family or pets who need your attention and rescue.

flaws.name: Repair
flaws.summary: You don't heal naturally and must be repaired.

flaws.name: Requirement/Severe Requirement
flaws.summary: Something you must periodically satisfy; a desperate, immediate need is a Severe Requirement (Condition).

flaws.name: Restriction
flaws.summary: Fewer legal rights than an average person.

flaws.name: Secret
flaws.summary: A secret you must protect at all costs.

flaws.name: Secret Identity
flaws.summary: The classic superhero version of Secret.

flaws.name: Slow
flaws.summary: You move slowly; you may choose to fail speed-related Agility rolls.

flaws.name: Unlucky/Jinx
flaws.summary: Once per issue the GM can inflict a free misfortune on you (Unlucky) or a nearby ally (Jinx).

flaws.name: Unusual Looks
flaws.summary: An off-putting appearance; redundant with Frightening.

flaws.name: Unusual Shape
flaws.summary: A non-human body shape with practical drawbacks.

flaws.name: Vulnerability
flaws.summary: Defenses are halved against one attack, effect or weapon.

flaws.name: Wanted
flaws.summary: Authorities are actively hunting you.
